args.code:
# The cipher bytes from address 0x402060
cipher = [0x79, 0xc5, 0x06, 0x4d, 0xc8, 0x2c, 0x5f, 0x93, 0xf7, 0x56, 0xb8, 0x2a, 0x5e, 0xcc, 0x2f, 0x97, 0xf6, 0x5a, 0x8d, 0xf0, 0x20, 0x99, 0x16]

# Algorithm:
# dl starts at 0x33
# dl += input[i]
# then compare dl with cipher[i]
# 
# So:
# cipher[0] = (0x33 + input[0]) & 0xFF
# cipher[1] = (0x33 + input[0] + input[1]) & 0xFF
# etc.
#
# To recover:
# input[0] = (cipher[0] - 0x33) & 0xFF
# input[i] = (cipher[i] - cipher[i-1]) & 0xFF (for i>0)

result = []
result.append((cipher[0] - 0x33) & 0xFF)

for i in range(1, len(cipher)):
    result.append((cipher[i] - cipher[i-1]) & 0xFF)

flag = ''.join(chr(c) for c in result)
print(f"Recovered flag: {flag}")
print(f"Length: {len(flag)}")
print(f"Bytes: {result}")
